name: Xenia
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.
